Greg Abbott

Republican candidate for Governor, Texas · Incumbent

Governor of Texas

Governor since 2015, seeking a fourth term. Polls in September and early October showed a close race; a YouGov poll from Sept. 28 to Oct. 5 had Hinojosa at 48% and Abbott at 47%, within the margin of error.

Where Abbott stands

Property taxes
Campaigns on property tax relief and has pursued tax cuts during his tenure.
Schools
Championed the education savings account program; proposes limiting classroom devices and requiring 70% of district funding to go to classroom instruction.
Higher education
Proposes tuition discounts for summer courses at four-year Texas universities.
Border and public safety
Campaigns on border security.
